rows.speaker: Jamil
rows.en: I'll go over the operation once more.
rows.display_text: 「I'll go over the operation once more.」

rows.speaker: Jamil
rows.en: Combat time is 4 minutes. The objective is to wipe out the enemy and earn 800,000 or more in funds.
rows.display_text:
「Combat time is 4 minutes. The objective
is to wipe out the enemy and earn
800,000 or more in funds.」

rows.speaker: Garrod
rows.en: Hold on, Jamil. Something's coming!
rows.display_text: 「Hold on, Jamil. Something's coming!」

rows.speaker: Kira
rows.en: Enemy reinforcements...!? No... it's not that!
rows.display_text:
「Enemy reinforcements...!? No... it's not
that!」

rows.speaker: Kamille
rows.en: Jerid and Yazan!
rows.display_text: 「Jerid and Yazan!」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: ...Our mission isn't to fight you.
rows.display_text: 「...Our mission isn't to fight you.」

rows.speaker: Mouar
rows.en: We've come to put down the bandits. We have no intention of engaging you.
rows.display_text:
「We've come to put down the bandits. We
have no intention of engaging you.」

rows.speaker: Roybea
rows.en: Heh... so the military's here to help us out. This oughta make things easy.
rows.display_text:
「Heh... so the military's here to help us
out. This oughta make things easy.」

rows.speaker: Witz
rows.en: What are you talking about!? We won't get any funds for whatever units they shoot down!
rows.display_text:
「What are you talking about!? We won't
get any funds for whatever units they
shoot down!」

rows.speaker: Quattro
rows.en: But since they've made it clear they have no intention of engaging, we can't very well attack them.
rows.display_text:
「But since they've made it clear they
have no intention of engaging, we can't
very well attack them.」

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: Then we've got no choice but to beat them to it and put down the bandits ourselves.
rows.display_text:
「Then we've got no choice but to beat
them to it and put down the bandits
ourselves.」

rows.speaker: Shinn
rows.en: A race against the Titans, huh...! Can't afford to lose that!
rows.display_text:
「A race against the Titans, huh...! Can't
afford to lose that!」

rows.speaker: Jamil
rows.en: We're carrying out the operation as planned. But don't lay a hand on the Titans' units.
rows.display_text:
「We're carrying out the operation as
planned. But don't lay a hand on the
Titans' units.」

rows.speaker: Jamil
rows.en: Our enemy is the bandits. Take them down before the Titans do.
rows.display_text:
「Our enemy is the bandits. Take them
down before the Titans do.」

rows.speaker: Toshiya
rows.en: Alright! The enemy's wiped out!
rows.display_text: 「Alright! The enemy's wiped out!」

rows.speaker: Kiraken
rows.en: Julie! How are we doing on funds!?
rows.display_text: 「Julie! How are we doing on funds!?」

rows.speaker: Julie
rows.en: Funds earned: {tm}. Target cleared.
rows.display_text: 「Funds earned: {tm}. Target cleared.」

rows.speaker: Jiron
rows.en: A flawless operation success! That's us for you!
rows.display_text:
「A flawless operation success! That's us
for you!」

rows.speaker: Kei
rows.en: The Titans pulled back too, so I'd call this case closed.
rows.display_text:
「The Titans pulled back too, so I'd call
this case closed.」

rows.speaker: Julie
rows.en: By the way, according to my calculations, the theoretical ceiling is over a million.
rows.display_text:
「By the way, according to my
calculations, the theoretical ceiling is
over a million.」

rows.speaker: Kiraken
rows.en: The operation was a success and you're still all about the money. You really are stingy.
rows.display_text:
「The operation was a success and you're
still all about the money. You really are
stingy.」

rows.speaker: Kamille
rows.en: So the Titans pulled back too...
rows.display_text: 「So the Titans pulled back too...」

rows.speaker: Jiron
rows.en: No need to worry about the ones who already left.
rows.display_text:
「No need to worry about the ones who
already left.」

rows.speaker: Julie
rows.en: Funds earned: {tm}. Unfortunately, we're in the red.
rows.display_text:
「Funds earned: {tm}. Unfortunately,
we're in the red.」

rows.speaker: Kei
rows.en: So that means the operation's a failure, huh...
rows.display_text:
「So that means the operation's a failure,
huh...」

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: Well... guess we'll just have to chalk this one up as volunteer work.
rows.display_text:
「Well... guess we'll just have to chalk
this one up as volunteer work.」

rows.speaker: Kappei
rows.en: Tch! Being a hero of justice sure isn't easy!
rows.display_text:
「Tch! Being a hero of justice sure isn't
easy!」

rows.speaker: Jamil
rows.en: Damn it...! The 4-minute operation time has passed!
rows.display_text:
「Damn it...! The 4-minute operation time
has passed!」

rows.speaker: Julie
rows.en: Keep this up any longer and we'll just dig the deficit deeper.
rows.display_text:
「Keep this up any longer and we'll just
dig the deficit deeper.」

rows.speaker: Kiraken
rows.en: That doesn't mean we can just abandon the bandits, though!
rows.display_text:
「That doesn't mean we can just abandon
the bandits, though!」

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: Well... guess from here on out, we'll just have to call it volunteer work.
rows.display_text:
「Well... guess from here on out, we'll
just have to call it volunteer work.」

rows.speaker: Kei
rows.en: Guess it's 'a samurai keeps his toothpick even on an empty stomach.' Man, what a rough world...
rows.display_text:
「Guess it's 'a samurai keeps his
toothpick even on an empty stomach.' Man,
what a rough world...」

rows.speaker: Elchi
rows.en: You're saying a group of bandits is rampaging around using unmanned mobile suits!?
rows.display_text:
「You're saying a group of bandits is
rampaging around using unmanned mobile
suits!?」

rows.speaker: Jamil
rows.en: We received a request from the local residents asking us to do something about it.
rows.display_text:
「We received a request from the local
residents asking us to do something about
it.」

rows.speaker: Elchi
rows.en: Let's do it! With our operating funds running dry, we've got no choice but to take it on!
rows.display_text:
「Let's do it! With our operating funds
running dry, we've got no choice but to
take it on!」

rows.speaker: Bright
rows.en: Is earning money the objective here?
rows.display_text: 「Is earning money the objective here?」

rows.speaker: Shaya
rows.en: Isn't that fine, though? Helping people in trouble and padding our funds at the same time -- that's killing two birds with one stone.
rows.display_text:
「Helping people in trouble while padding
our funds -- two birds, one stone, isn't
it?」

rows.speaker: Jamil
rows.en: But if we're going to do this, I don't want to end up in the red...
rows.display_text:
「But if we're going to do this, I don't
want to end up in the red...」

rows.speaker: Julie
rows.en: The calculations are already done. We sortie with two warships and six squads, combat time within four minutes...
rows.display_text:
「The calculations are already done. We
sortie with two warships and six squads,
combat time within four minutes...」

rows.speaker: Julie
rows.en: In that state, if we earn 800,000 in funds, we'll come out in the black.
rows.display_text:
「In that state, if we earn 800,000 in
funds, we'll come out in the black.」

rows.speaker: Shaya
rows.en: As expected of you, Julie. Perfect.
rows.display_text: 「As expected of you, Julie. Perfect.」

rows.speaker: Julie
rows.en: Leave the money calculations to me.
rows.display_text: 「Leave the money calculations to me.」

rows.speaker: Jamil
rows.en: Then, based on Julie's simulation, we begin the operation.
rows.display_text:
「Then, based on Julie's simulation, we
begin the operation.」

rows.speaker: Jamil
rows.en: We sortie with two warships and six squads. Combat time is 4 minutes. Target funds earned: 800,000 or more.
rows.display_text:
「We sortie with two warships and six
squads. Combat time is 4 minutes. Target
funds earned: 800,000 or more.」
